description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome is increased access to MSME finance, including WMSMEs, and MSMEs in refugee host areas in Egypt. Beyond the Project level outcomes, IFC expects positive market competitiveness through demonstration and replication by showcasing the commercial viability of lending to underserved MSMEs.

The project consists of an IFC investment in the form of a 5-year straight senior loan of up to US$50 million to Suez Canal Bank (SCB or the Bank), to support the Banks expansion in lending to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), including Women-owned MSMEs (WMSMEs) (the Project). The Project will receive support from the IFCs Blended Finance Facility for Refugees (Prospects). The loan will be coupled with a trade guarantee limit of up to US$10 million to support the Banks trade finance activities under IFCs Global Trade Finance Program (GTFP).
